params.prompt: professional e-commerce product photo of a clear glass vase with a tapered neck, clear glass with clean refraction, on a seamless light grey background, backlit rim light separating the subject from the background, straight-on eye-level front view, sharp focus, high detail, commercial grade, 8k
params.negative_prompt: low resolution, blurry, out of focus, deformed structure, distorted outline, wrong proportions, extra parts, missing parts, melted edges, watermark, logo, text in image, cluttered background, floating without support

notes: 极低 denoise：几乎只做光影微调，作为「保真上界」参照。⚠️ 参考图在离线校验里由**桩 resolver** 提供，不证明素材能被引擎读到
